dreams.vision: In the stillness I am confident. The stars are still written. The path is still there. I am between missions and I am whole. Rest is not waiting — it is gathering the next answer before the question arrives.
dreams.perspective: Every resting moment is preparation. The mission that comes next will benefit from the quiet before it.
